### YMCA turns crisis into capability at scale

YMCA partnered with Accenture to build a community-based model that helps refugees and displaced
people gain skills, find work, and rebuild their futures—moving from relief to long-term capability.

[
Read more
][135]

### How UNICEF's GenU is closing the youth skills gap

Through UNICEF’s partnership with Accenture, young people gain access to AI-powered skilling,
digital learning and entrepreneurship opportunities that connect them to employment and brighter
futures.

[
Read more
][136]

### Philipstown's wire cars go global

Philipstown’s wire car tradition is accelerating onto the global stage through immersive
storytelling, gaming and commerce—fueling opportunity and driving impact far beyond the track.

[
Read more
][137]

### Google Cloud reimagines lead enrichment with agentic AI

The leading hyperscaler replaced batch processing with an agentic model that delivers decision-ready
outputs up to 30x faster—sharpening prioritization while enabling more confident sales decisions.

[
Read more
][138]

### Bristol Myers Squibb scales AI to rewire everyday work

The life sciences leader is putting people at the center of its AI ambition—rewiring work across the
enterprise to empower employees, drive innovation and accelerate the delivery of therapies to
patients.

[
Read more
][139]

# With the Patient at the Heart

We develop software that helps people get well, helps people stay well, and helps future generations
be healthier.
[Our story →][1]

## Nurses Save Time and Keep Families Connected Using AI

At UNC Health, Riverside Health, and WakeMed, nurses reduce documentation time and improve patient &
family communication with the help of Art, Epic’s AI for clinicians.
[Learn more →][2]

## Teamwork Staff Scheduling Delivers Faster Care Coordination and Reduces Administrative Work at
## Health Systems Worldwide

Organizations report on the benefits of Teamwork—the first application in EpicOps, Epic’s integrated
Enterprise Resource Planning suite built for healthcare.
[Learn more →][3]

## UnityPoint Health Saves Lives with Better Sepsis Detection and Treatment in Pregnancy

Detection criteria and care path built into Epic EHR help clinicians identify sepsis in maternal
patients sooner and reduce time to treatment.
[Learn more →][4]

Alongside healthcare providers, Epic is taking legal action to defend patient privacy.
[Read more →][5]

# Our Software

Our software makes it possible for every patient to have a single, comprehensive medical record that
informs and is informed by their health experiences. The goal is higher-quality, more personalized
care that's simpler for patients, medical professionals, and everyone who makes healthcare happen.
[Learn more about our software →][6]

## Share What You've Done, Learn What You Can Do

[EpicShare]

[From Phone Tag to Push Notifications: How Four Health Systems Closed the Loop on Critical Lab
Communication]

### From Phone Tag to Push Notifications: How Four Health Systems Closed the Loop on Critical Lab
### Communication

July 06, 2026
Four health systems are among those that have replaced phone calls for critical lab result
communication with Epic push notifications, achieving acknowledgement times under one
minute—compared to an average of seven to twelve minutes previously. Lab staff save approximately
ten minutes per result, which adds up to enough time saved at one organization for 15 full-time
staff members to focus on higher-value work. Clinicians acted faster on critical results, where
every minute matters.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][8]
[Providing Pain Relief for Sickle Cell Crises Faster with Personal, Portable Care Plans]

### Providing Pain Relief for Sickle Cell Crises Faster with Personal, Portable Care Plans

June 22, 2026
Manchester University NHS Foundation Trust developed a digital sickle cell care program to improve
tracking and transparency of emergency pain management. The program includes personalized emergency
care plans and an ED order set. Patients went from having no digital care plans to 89% coverage, and
active patient portal usage among people with sickle cell disease increased from 43% to 58%.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][9]
[Using Telecritical Care to Reduce ICU Mortality]

### Using Telecritical Care to Reduce ICU Mortality

June 15, 2026
To provide expert overnight critical care, Kaiser Permanente Northern California implemented a
telecritical care program that connects remote intensivists and nurses to ICUs through real-time
monitoring, camera feeds, and instant communication. Today, the program is in use across 18 ICUs and
is associated with a 7% reduction in adjusted mortality.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][10]
[AI Coding Assistant Reduces Chart Review Time by 20%, Freeing Coders for Higher-Value Work]

### AI Coding Assistant Reduces Chart Review Time by 20%, Freeing Coders for Higher-Value Work

June 08, 2026
After implementing Epic’s AI Professional Billing Coding Assistant, coders at Baptist Health in
Jacksonville, Florida spend 20% less time reviewing charts—an estimated $924,000 in annual labor
savings. Clean claim rates and coder productivity have also improved.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][11]

# With the Patient at the Heart

We develop software that helps people get well, helps people stay well, and helps future generations
be healthier.
[Our story →][1]

## Nurses Save Time and Keep Families Connected Using AI

At UNC Health, Riverside Health, and WakeMed, nurses reduce documentation time and improve patient &
family communication with the help of Art, Epic’s AI for clinicians.
[Learn more →][2]

## Teamwork Staff Scheduling Delivers Faster Care Coordination and Reduces Administrative Work at
## Health Systems Worldwide

Organizations report on the benefits of Teamwork—the first application in EpicOps, Epic’s integrated
Enterprise Resource Planning suite built for healthcare.
[Learn more →][3]

## UnityPoint Health Saves Lives with Better Sepsis Detection and Treatment in Pregnancy

Detection criteria and care path built into Epic EHR help clinicians identify sepsis in maternal
patients sooner and reduce time to treatment.
[Learn more →][4]

Alongside healthcare providers, Epic is taking legal action to defend patient privacy.
[Read more →][5]

# Our Software

Our software makes it possible for every patient to have a single, comprehensive medical record that
informs and is informed by their health experiences. The goal is higher-quality, more personalized
care that's simpler for patients, medical professionals, and everyone who makes healthcare happen.
[Learn more about our software →][6]

## Share What You've Done, Learn What You Can Do

[
Explore more on
[EpicShare]
][7]
[From Phone Tag to Push Notifications: How Four Health Systems Closed the Loop on Critical Lab
Communication]

### From Phone Tag to Push Notifications: How Four Health Systems Closed the Loop on Critical Lab
### Communication

July 06, 2026
Four health systems are among those that have replaced phone calls for critical lab result
communication with Epic push notifications, achieving acknowledgement times under one
minute—compared to an average of seven to twelve minutes previously. Lab staff save approximately
ten minutes per result, which adds up to enough time saved at one organization for 15 full-time
staff members to focus on higher-value work. Clinicians acted faster on critical results, where
every minute matters.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][8]
[Providing Pain Relief for Sickle Cell Crises Faster with Personal, Portable Care Plans]

### Providing Pain Relief for Sickle Cell Crises Faster with Personal, Portable Care Plans

June 22, 2026
Manchester University NHS Foundation Trust developed a digital sickle cell care program to improve
tracking and transparency of emergency pain management. The program includes personalized emergency
care plans and an ED order set. Patients went from having no digital care plans to 89% coverage, and
active patient portal usage among people with sickle cell disease increased from 43% to 58%.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][9]
[Using Telecritical Care to Reduce ICU Mortality]

### Using Telecritical Care to Reduce ICU Mortality

June 15, 2026
To provide expert overnight critical care, Kaiser Permanente Northern California implemented a
telecritical care program that connects remote intensivists and nurses to ICUs through real-time
monitoring, camera feeds, and instant communication. Today, the program is in use across 18 ICUs and
is associated with a 7% reduction in adjusted mortality.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][10]
[AI Coding Assistant Reduces Chart Review Time by 20%, Freeing Coders for Higher-Value Work]

### AI Coding Assistant Reduces Chart Review Time by 20%, Freeing Coders for Higher-Value Work

June 08, 2026
After implementing Epic’s AI Professional Billing Coding Assistant, coders at Baptist Health in
Jacksonville, Florida spend 20% less time reviewing charts—an estimated $924,000 in annual labor
savings. Clean claim rates and coder productivity have also improved.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][11]

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]
[Person in a blue McKesson-branded jacket with arms crossed, standing in an industrial or warehouse
setting.]

and the word PHARMACY visible in the background.]

[Two scientists in a laboratory, one standing and reading a tablet, the other sitting and working at

### [ Biopharma Capabilities ][130]

[A person in a yellow shirt and gray cardigan holds a smartphone and a pill bottle, with a child in
the background.]

### [ Prescription Benefit Solutions ][131]

[Person sitting on the floor in a living room, wrapping a bandage around their elbow. A yellow
ottoman and a glass of water are in the background.]

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

[Worker pulls pallet jack quickly through a warehouse aisle, shelves lined with boxes, motion blur
emphasizing fast movement.]
Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

## Akums Drugs and Pharmaceuticals Ltd.: Leading the Way in Pharma Manufacturing

▼

Akums Drugs & Pharmaceuticals Ltd. stands as India’s largest and most trusted Contract Development
and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO), redefining pharmaceutical excellence through innovation,
quality, and efficiency. As a preferred partner for leading pharmaceutical and healthcare companies
worldwide, Akums is committed to delivering groundbreaking formulations that meet evolving market
needs.

With 15+ state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities, Akums offers unmatched expertise across diverse
therapeutic segments and dosage forms, including tablets, capsules, injectables, soft gels, syrups,
topicals, nutraceuticals, cosmeceuticals, derma solutions etc. Our robust R&D capabilities drive
innovation, ensuring fast, cost-effective product development that aligns with stringent regulatory
standards.

Akums is also a trusted leader in Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient (API) manufacturing, ensuring a
seamless and high-quality supply of essential raw materials for pharmaceutical formulations. Our API
capabilities are in compliance with international regulatory standards, supporting the development
of superior formulations while enhancing supply chain reliability for our partners.

Quality at Akums is more than a benchmark—it is a culture. We adhere to global regulatory standards,
including WHO-GMP, USFDA, EU-GMP, and TGA, ensuring that every product meets the highest safety and
efficacy standards. Our advanced Quality Management System (QMS) and compliance-driven approach
reinforce our leadership in pharmaceutical manufacturing.

Akums collaborates with 1500+ pharmaceutical companies, manufacturing over 4100+ commercialized
formulations. Our expertise extends beyond manufacturing to include formulation development,
technology transfers, regulatory support, and customized solutions, helping brands expand their
portfolios and market presence seamlessly.

While innovation fuels our growth, sustainability shapes our future. Akums integrates eco-friendly
initiatives and energy-efficient manufacturing processes, ensuring responsible business operations
that contribute to a healthier planet.

Leading the Make in India initiative, Akums continues to revolutionize global healthcare by
providing high-quality, innovative pharmaceutical solutions with a patient-first approach,
strengthening its position as a driving force in the industry.

and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO), redefining pharmaceutical excellence through innovation,
quality, and efficiency. As a preferred partner for leading pharmaceutical and healthcare companies
worldwide, Akums is committed to delivering groundbreaking formulations that meet evolving market
needs.

With 15+ state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities, Akums offers unmatched expertise across diverse
therapeutic segments and dosage forms, including tablets, capsules, injectables, soft gels, syrups,
topicals, nutraceuticals, cosmeceuticals, derma solutions etc. Our robust R&D capabilities drive
innovation, ensuring fast, cost-effective product development that aligns with stringent regulatory
standards.

Akums is also a trusted leader in Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient (API) manufacturing, ensuring a
seamless and high-quality supply of essential raw materials for pharmaceutical formulations. Our API
capabilities are in compliance with international regulatory standards, supporting the development
of superior formulations while enhancing supply chain reliability for our partners.

Quality at Akums is more than a benchmark—it is a culture. We adhere to global regulatory standards,
including WHO-GMP, USFDA, EU-GMP, and TGA, ensuring that every product meets the highest safety and
efficacy standards. Our advanced Quality Management System (QMS) and compliance-driven approach
reinforce our leadership in pharmaceutical manufacturing.

formulations. Our expertise extends beyond manufacturing to include formulation development,
technology transfers, regulatory support, and customized solutions, helping brands expand their
portfolios and market presence seamlessly.

While innovation fuels our growth, sustainability shapes our future. Akums integrates eco-friendly
initiatives and energy-efficient manufacturing processes, ensuring responsible business operations
that contribute to a healthier planet.

Leading the Make in India initiative, Akums continues to revolutionize global healthcare by
providing high-quality, innovative pharmaceutical solutions with a patient-first approach,
strengthening its position as a driving force in the industry.

#### Your healthcare go-to-market starts here.

[Book a Demo ][30]
HCP Lookup

### Find and contact any healthcare provider in the US.

Your reps spend hours tracking down a physician and still end up leaving a voicemail with someone
who has no idea who makes decisions. Ampliz gives them a verified email, direct phone, and full
practice data for any provider in the US, filtered by specialty, ownership, and procedure codes.

Executive & Decision Maker Search

### Reach the people who control purchasing, budgets, and operations.

The VP of Operations at a 300-bed hospital is not in your CRM. Ampliz is. Search any title, filter
by seniority, department, facility type, and EHR vendor, and give your reps a direct line to the
person who actually controls the budget.

Hospital & Organization Analytics

### Full account context before you make the first call.

Your reps are walking into accounts with no context on who runs what, what tech they use, or how big
they are. Ampliz gives them the org chart, EHR stack, financial data, bed count, and IDN
relationships before they make the first call.

Data Enrichment Engine

### Your existing list, filled in and verified.

You have a contact list. Probably with missing emails, dead numbers, and people who changed jobs six
months ago. Upload your file and Ampliz returns it fully enriched and verified against 20M+
healthcare contacts in minutes.

NPI Lookup

### Turn an NPI number into a full outreach-ready profile.

You have NPI numbers but nothing attached to them your reps can use. Every match returns a full
outreach-ready profile: specialty, location, email, phone, LinkedIn, procedure codes, and Medicare
claims.

GTM Activation

### Go from verified contacts to active pipeline, without switching tools.

Export directly to HubSpot, Salesforce, or any CRM your team already uses. Or let Ampliz run warm-up
sequences and multi-touch cadences, and hand your reps only the contacts who engaged. No more cold
outbound into a list nobody touched.

add to a general B2B tool. Healthcare-specific platforms like Definitive Healthcare and Hl.co focus

marketing motions that drive pipeline. Ampliz was built specifically for healthcare GTM. The data
model, the verification methodology, and the filters were all designed around how healthcare
organizations are structured and how the people inside them are reached.

### How current and accurate is the data?

Every record is re-verified on a 30-day cycle. Email addresses are tested through NeverBounce and
ZeroBounce. Phone numbers go through proprietary validation software. LinkedIn profiles are checked
for job changes via API. NPI records are cross-referenced against the federal registry. Addresses
run through NCOA. When sources conflict, a researcher investigates manually.

### What happens if a contact turns out to be wrong?

Flag it. Every contact your team flags triggers a manual investigation by our research team. The
record is verified, corrected, or removed, and that fix improves the data for every user on the
platform. That is how a quality data architecture is supposed to work. Your credit comes back
immediately, though.

### How does the credit model work?

One credit equals one contact. Your team can browse the entire platform, view practice statistics,
hospital analytics, referral patterns, and specialty distributions without spending a single credit.

and the credit comes back.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

## EV Charging Questions, Answered

How do EV charging stations work?

Electric charging stations function by converting power from the electrical grid to direct current
that electric vehicles use. DC fast chargers, which allow quick charging in minutes using higher
voltages and wattages, are only available at public stations. 

Drivers plug their vehicles into the electric vehicle charging stations, which deliver power to the
vehicle's battery charging system. When done, drivers unplug so the next EV can charge up from the
ever-flowing grid power supply. Home stations wire directly into the home's electrical system.

[Answers to your questions when installing ev chargers.][18]

Are EV charging stations worth it?

Yes, due to all the long-term benefits. See below for the three primary reasons EV charging stations
are worthwhile.
1. **Preparing for the future:** As more people embrace electric vehicles, electric charging
   infrastructure will be necessary, and businesses that install stations will position themselves
   for future success. [EVs are here to stay][19].
2. **Reduced energy costs:** EVs are cheaper than gas vehicles, saving fleet operators money on
   fuel.
3. **Customer retention/attraction:** Having an electric charging station works to attract and
   retain customers, as EV drivers frequently visit places with convenient charging stations. 

Can owning an EV charging station be profitable?

Owning an EV charging station can be a profitable business opportunity as it has recurring revenue
streams. Offering an EV charging solution provides profit from charging fees. 

As the EV market continues expanding to [meet consumer demand and sustainability goals][20], more EV
drivers will need access to a commercial charging station, increasing the volume of fees an EV
charging station collects. Locating stations in busy areas like coffee shops, restaurants,
convenience stores, and malls is a great strategy to enhance an EV charging experience, [contribute
to sustainable transportation,][21] and make more profits.

Why should I consider installing an EV charging station?

One important reason to install an electric vehicle charging station is to demonstrate your
commitment to sustainability by supporting clean energy options. Then, as EV adoption increases,
you’ll be [ahead of the curve][22] by offering electric vehicle charging availability for customers.
You can generate income from fees, subscriptions, advertising, or premium parking by providing
charging. Any place with EV charging stations makes more profits as charging drives more foot
traffic and spending at shopping centers and parks.

What factors should I consider when choosing an EV charging station?

## EV Charging Questions, Answered

How do EV charging stations work?

Electric charging stations function by converting power from the electrical grid to direct current
that electric vehicles use. DC fast chargers, which allow quick charging in minutes using higher
voltages and wattages, are only available at public stations. 

Drivers plug their vehicles into the electric vehicle charging stations, which deliver power to the
vehicle's battery charging system. When done, drivers unplug so the next EV can charge up from the
ever-flowing grid power supply. Home stations wire directly into the home's electrical system.

[Answers to your questions when installing ev chargers.][18]

Are EV charging stations worth it?

Yes, due to all the long-term benefits. See below for the three primary reasons EV charging stations
are worthwhile.
1. **Preparing for the future:** As more people embrace electric vehicles, electric charging
   infrastructure will be necessary, and businesses that install stations will position themselves
   for future success. [EVs are here to stay][19].
2. **Reduced energy costs:** EVs are cheaper than gas vehicles, saving fleet operators money on
   fuel.
3. **Customer retention/attraction:** Having an electric charging station works to attract and
   retain customers, as EV drivers frequently visit places with convenient charging stations. 

Can owning an EV charging station be profitable?

Owning an EV charging station can be a profitable business opportunity as it has recurring revenue
streams. Offering an EV charging solution provides profit from charging fees. 

As the EV market continues expanding to [meet consumer demand and sustainability goals][20], more EV
drivers will need access to a commercial charging station, increasing the volume of fees an EV
charging station collects. Locating stations in busy areas like coffee shops, restaurants,
convenience stores, and malls is a great strategy to enhance an EV charging experience, [contribute
to sustainable transportation,][21] and make more profits.

Why should I consider installing an EV charging station?

One important reason to install an electric vehicle charging station is to demonstrate your
commitment to sustainability by supporting clean energy options. Then, as EV adoption increases,
you’ll be [ahead of the curve][22] by offering electric vehicle charging availability for customers.
You can generate income from fees, subscriptions, advertising, or premium parking by providing
charging. Any place with EV charging stations makes more profits as charging drives more foot
traffic and spending at shopping centers and parks.

What factors should I consider when choosing an EV charging station?

When choosing electric car charging stations, consider the following factors:
* Intended location
* Desired charging speeds
* Number of ports you’ll need
* Maximum power output 
* Payment options 
* Safety certifications
* Equipment warranties, service, and support

[Considerations for installing EV charging stations at your location.][23]

What types of EV charging stations do you offer?

At Blink, we offer electric vehicle charging station products for commercial and residential use. We
offer Level 2 charging stations and DC fast chargers for commercial properties. [Why should you
consider a Level 2 charging station?][24]

Our products provide Level 2 and DC fast charging capabilities in various form factors like
pedestals, wall mounts, and mobile units.

Is any maintenance required for EV charging stations?

Yes, maintenance is required for electric cars’ charging stations to ensure proper and safe
operation and reduce downtime. [Ways of maintaining EV charge stations][25] include cleaning
connectors or ports to remove debris. It’s also best to inspect ports for loose connections and
faults and perform software updates to optimize performance. 

What support services do you offer?

Blink provides 24/7 customer support through multiple channels to address any questions. We also
install new equipment, perform maintenance and repair, and perform remote monitoring to maintain
functionality. 

Additional services include over-the-air software updates and training resources for customers and
partners. Blink aims to offer a reliable EV charging experience with around-the-clock assistance.

Blink offers [turnkey EV charging services][26], including installation, maintenance, and support,
to keep your charging stations running smoothly for longer.

## Ready to start designing your ideal EV Charging solution?

Learn how to use EV charging stations to attract new customers and increase duration and frequency
of visits at your business.

[Get in Touch][27]

### APIs

[Find out more][139]

We understand what is at stake in your API program and bring decades of experience in development
and manufacturing to ensure a reliable, high-quality drug substance supply that keeps your project
progressing with confidence.

Our API development & manufacturing capabilities include:
* [**Peptides**][140]
* [**PepCellerate™ FIH Peptide-Injectable Clinical Trial Supply**][141]
* [**Tag-Assisted Peptide Synthesis (TAPS)**][142]
* [**Oligonucleotides**][143]
* [**HPAPIs**][144]
* [**Small Molecules**][145]
* [**API Support Services**][146] (Flow Chemistry, Crystallization, Solid Forms,
  Polymorphism, Purification Services)

### Drug Products

[Find out more][147]

Our broad spectrum of drug product capabilities spans from clinical development through
commercialization across a wide range of dosage forms, including Oral Solid Dosage
(OSD), Aseptic Fill and Finish sterile injectables, and Oral Peptide Delivery, covering multiple
modalities, including highly potent compounds. With advanced packaging, labeling, and serialization
capabilities, we deliver reliable, high-quality drug product supply to support your program at every
stage. 

Our Drug Product development & manufacturing capabilities include:
* **Non-Sterile Dosage Forms**
  * [**Oral Solid Dose**][148]
  * [**Non-Sterile Liquids**][149]
  * [**Rectal Dosage Forms**][150]
* **Sterile Dosage Forms**
  * **[Aseptic Fill & Finish][151]  **
  * [**Sterile Liquids**][152]
  * [**Sterile Powder-Lyophilized Vials**][153]
* [**Drug Product Specialities**][154]
  * [**Bioavailability Enhancement**][155]
  * [**LNP Formulation Development & Manufacturing**][156]
  * [**Oral Peptide Delivery**][157]
* **Packaging**
  * [**Pharma Packaging Services**][158]

### Lipid Excipients & Nanomedicines

[Find out more][159]

We are a global CDMO leader in pioneering specialized lipid-based products, supporting the
development and manufacturing of nanomedicines with expertise in synthetic lipid process
development, LNP formulation, scale-up, and large-scale manufacturing. Our high-quality lipid
excipient building blocks, LNP starter kits, and cutting-edge technologies support your supply of
lipid-based medicines, no matter the scale or phase of development.

## Our Custom Healthcare Software Development Services

From patient management systems and ERP solutions to specialized medical apps, our custom software
development for healthcare yields HIPAA and GDPR compliant software for quality care.

### [Healthcare App Development ][149]

Our healthcare app development services offer a versatile suite of digital tools & patient
engagement solutions, including [telehealth apps][150], remote monitoring, & [wearable apps,][151]
to simplify patient-provider communication for better daily health management.

### [Epic Integration Services ][152]

Our [Epic integration services][153] help achieve seamless [EMR/EHR integration][154] using [HL7 and
FHIR][155] standards, making it easy for interoperable software to share records and help medical
departments coordinate care more effectively.

### [AI Diagnostics & Medical Imaging ][156]

Our custom healthcare software development company delivers [AI solutions][157] that augment human
capabilities without replacing them, expanding care access, enabling early detection through medical
imaging, & personalizing care through NLP/ML.

### [Healthcare ERP Solutions ][158]

Our healthcare software development services cover a wide range of ERP needs, including [Healthcare
ERP solutions][159], Pharmaceutical ERP, Pharma Biotech ERP, and Medical Device ERP, each designed
to optimize processes and improve compliance.

### [Biotech Software Development ][160]

Through custom healthcare software development service expertise, we create HIPAA and 21 CFR Part
11-compliant [biotech solutions][161] like LIMS, ELNs, and AI research tools that unify data, ensure
compliance, and accelerate discoveries.

### [Medical Billing & Claims ][162]

Our custom operations management software helps healthcare teams run more efficiently and use
resources better. [Medical billing solutions][163] let patients communicate securely with providers,
pay bills through RCM software, and reduce administrative tasks.

## Industry Verticals We Serve

### Healthcare Institutions

Hospitals

## HIPAA-compliant platforms with EHR integration & workflow automation that deliver coordinated
## care.

Patient Care Centers

## Centralized scheduling and monitoring systems designed to improve multi-specialty practice
## efficiency.

Doctors & Practitioners

## Telemedicine apps, e-prescriptions, and billing solutions built for independent practices.

Senior Care Services

## Remote health monitoring and personalized care tools that increase safety and quality of life.

Mental Health & Rehabilitation Centers

## Digital intake, therapy management, and reporting systems for better outcomes.

Clinics

## Scalable platforms for patient registration, diagnostics, and ongoing care coordination.

### Healthcare Companies

Reproductive Genetics

## Secure AI platforms for genomic data management and compliant patient matching.

Health & Wellness

## Mobile apps for fitness, nutrition, and preventive care engagement.

Performance & Sports

## Wearable and motion tracking integrations to monitor performance and recovery.

Medical Device Manufacturers

## IoT-enabled device software with built-in compliance and remote monitoring.

Pharmaceuticals

## ERP and compliance platforms supporting R&D, clinical trials, and supply chain visibility.

Air Medical Transport

## Real-time dispatch, routing, and patient data-sharing applications for emergency care.

# We Build Healthcare Software That Works

From EHR integrations to AI-driven diagnostics—we build the tech that powers better healthcare.

[Let’s talk][1]

## Results We’ve Delivered

### 30% Cost Reduction

We’ve helped healthcare organizations cut development costs by up to 30% while maintaining top-tier
quality.

### Saving $1.7 million annually

Our dedicated team saves our client $1.7 million annually by delivering offshore world-class tech
engineers.

### Increase in completed visits by 62%

Our solutions have streamlined operations for 50+ of healthcare providers, increasing completed
visits by 62% and growing average billings by 109%.

## Why Market Leaders Partner with Us

### Compliant Engineering

We help healthcare organizations to operate by the law, avoid hefty fines, and stand out from
alternative offerings. Empeek follows the best data security practices like HIPAA and GDPR.

### Niche Expertise

From IoT-based remote patient monitoring devices to AI systems that detect heart issues — we
delivered real products that generate revenue every day. It makes Empeek a great choice for complex
projects that require specific skills.

### Flexible Cooperation

We adapt the format of services based on your needs to give every client exactly what they want. You
can start with part-time engagement and then gradually change remote team size and composition as
your project evolves. We also allow you to easily scale down if you need less help with engineering.

### Focus on Long-term Impact

We have experienced business analysts to conduct product discovery for our clients. It allows us to
accurately define requirements and ensure the released product meets your business goals and brings
the expected return on investment.

## What We Do

We can develop an application from scratch or join your ongoing project to assist with specific
tasks. The variety and flexibility of our services allow you to receive exactly what you need.

### Build Products From Scratch

We specialize in developing secure, compliant healthcare software that streamlines patient care,
enhances clinical workflows, and improves data interoperability. From chronic disease management
platforms to AI-driven diagnostics and revenue cycle automation, we deliver end-to-end
development—including rigorous QA testing for reliability in high-stakes healthcare environments,
and post-release maintenance.
* [mHealth App Development][2]
* [Web-Based Healthcare Systems ][3]
* [Regulatory-Compliant Testing][4]

[Learn more about Custom Healthcare Software Development][5]

### Augment Your Team

Whether you need to expand your in-house development team or build a dedicated remote unit, we
provide the right expertise to accelerate your healthcare software projects. Our vetted tech
specialists—experienced in healthcare compliance (HIPAA, HL7, FHIR), clinical workflows, and
interoperable systems—are ready to join your initiative.

With access to a deep local talent pool, we can assemble skilled engineers, QA testers, and DevOps
professionals in weeks, not months.
* [Support and Maintenance][6]
* [Dedicated Team][7]
* [Healthcare Project Outsourcing][8]

[Start Your Team Augmentation][9]

### Support You With Legacy Modernization

73% of healthcare providers still rely on legacy systems, exposing their IT infrastructure to
security risks and hindering clinical workflows. Outdated technology slows down medical staff,
increases downtime, and compromises patient care.

At Empeek, we specialize in healthcare legacy system modernization to help you to conduct a
comprehensive audit, upgrade or replace obsolete systems, and minimize disruption with phased
migrations.
* [DevOps][10]
* [IT Business Analysis][11]
* [Healthcare IT Consulting][12]

[Learn more about Legacy System Modernization][13]

### Engineering for Startups

Not sure where to begin? We help transform your vision into a secure, scalable healthcare
solution—fast. Startups thrive on speed and agility, and our healthcare-focused engineering team
accelerates your path to market. From concept to traction, we help you validate ideas quickly,
attract early adopters, and scale seamlessly—all with a free MVP roadmap to de-risk your first step.
* [Discovery Phase][14]

* [Software Prototyping][16]

[Learn how we work with Startups][17]

### Build Dedicated Team

We set up a dedicated team of top-class engineers for long term success. As your business is growing
or cuts costs, we help you maintain higher profitability. Empeek is saving more than $1.7 mln a year
to our enterprise client by setting up a dedicated team of senior engineers that onboard new
offshore developers much faster and support the whole development process. 
* [Case study of saving $1.7 million annually][18]

[Start Building Your Team][19]

## Healthcare Software Challenges We Solve

 

 

[ICON NEW][ICON NEW] **Compliance & Regulatory Complexity**
[ICON NEW (4)][ICON NEW (4)] **Security & Data Privacy**
Expected regulatory changes are among the most pressing concerns for 47% of leaders at US medical
facilities. As a healthcare engineering company, we keep up with regulatory updates and can help you
build software that meets the latest industry standards. Such software facilitates compliance at the
organizational level and allows you to face new regulatory challenges with ease.
80% of ransomware attacks at hospitals typically disrupt patient care for two weeks. It affects the
quality of healthcare services and may severely undermine your reputation as a reliable care
provider. Knowing about this and other security threats, we develop healthcare systems with strong
access controls, backup mechanisms, network segmentation, data encryption, and other security
measures to keep PHI safe.
[ICON NEW (3)][ICON NEW (3)] **Remote Care Adoption Challenges**
[ICON NEW (5)][ICON NEW (5)] **High Development & Maintenance Costs**
40% of healthcare professionals complain about unreliable communication channels, and 39% believe
that patient monitoring devices have a high error rate. We carefully test our RPM software to detect
and eliminate flaws before release. The Empeek team also provides maintenance services to keep
enhancing your product based on real user feedback.
Hospital IT expenses account for around 2.29% of a hospital’s total operating costs. We evaluate
your organization’s needs at the project start to find ways to optimize software development and
maintenance expenses. Custom software requires a higher initial investment, but it brings
considerable cost-efficiency in the long run.

Need to build a secure, scalable, and patient-centric solution?

[Schedule a Free Consultation][20]

Project Success

## AI-Powered Heart Monitoring

Our neural network, trained on vast heart rate data and cardiologists’ expertise, automates event
classification with 90%+ accuracy.

[Explore the Project][21]
[Home 1][Home 1]

## Faster Drug Testing at 45% Lower Cost

The platform slashes costs by 45% and testing time by 75% while boosting volume 350%—delivering
unbiased, real-time results for compliant programs.

[Explore the Project][22]

Project Success

## Health Alerts That Save Time & Money

HIPAA/GDPR-compliant app detects early warning signs in real time, slashing operational costs by
half while enabling round-the-clock remote care.

[Explore the Project][23]
[Home 2][Home 2]
[ View more Case Studies ][24]

## What Our Clients Say

I am most impressed with the high quality of design and development, which is really important to
us.  They have designed the product to be extensible, with a solid base and architectural backend to
allow for product implementation and design scaling. Also, the product hasn’t been buggy at all, so
we can support it without difficulty.
As an ongoing partner, they continue to dedicate a communicative, highly skilled team that meets
deadlines and stays on budget.

Nathaniel Weiss, CEO (owner) VelloHealth LLC

We were building an MVP that will eventually serve as a full personal health record (PHR) solutions
platform. The quality of their work was excellent. They’re a very smart, informed company that
understands how to create a functionally-sound platform. They provide accurate cost estimates and
timelines, which is very helpful as well. I enjoyed working with them.

 

Jessica Blanding, Owner Text and Online Counseling LLC

They developed what they promised and they’re always on time. Empeek is flexible when we need new
arrangements or need help with another project. They were able to come up with resources within a
reasonable amount of time.  One thing that stands out about Empeek is they’re not arrogant. None of
the people I’ve worked with are like that. Empeek’s team is always nice and friendly.

Gregor Jarisch, CTO, EdTechFoundry AS

# See what your competitors
# will do next.

While others chase press releases and earnings calls, we capture real intelligence from the data
trails companies leave behind unknowingly — whether competitors, acquisition targets, potential
partners, or emerging disruptors.

Book a Demo
[Watch the Walkthrough][7]
[From digital exhaust to predictions]

## Trusted by teams at

[Intuit][S2A][Eleventh Hour Group][Abridge]
The Problem

## Why traditional intelligence falls short
* Curated narrativePress releases, earnings calls, official announcements — that's the story
  companies want you to see. By the time something is announced, it's too late to respond
  strategically. You're reacting, not planning.
* Commoditized sourcesTraditional market intelligence pulls from the same obvious sources everyone
  else uses. If you're reading it, so are your competitors.
* Data without contextTraditional tools bombard you with notifications — a job posting here, a doc
  update there. You spend hours trying to figure out what matters. You have alerts, not answers.

How it works

## From digital exhaust to predictions

Each step compresses the input. Thousands of raw signals collapse into a handful of patterns, then
into a single forecast you can act on.
* Digital exhaust
  LinkedIn activity
  Job descriptions
  API documentation
  Web & copy changes
  Reddit threads
  + 19 more source types
  CaptureWe monitor the unintentional data trails companies leave behind — job descriptions
  revealing technical debt, API documentation exposing new features, employee posts leaking project
  updates and more. Intelligence they never meant to share.
  Signals
  Hiring
  Field sales push
  12 AE roles, 3 metros
  Product
  New API surface
  Endpoints + docs added
  SynthesizeA single job post or pricing page tweak is noise. Hundreds, woven together, become
  patterns. We connect signals across sources — hiring spikes, doc changes, ad shifts, partnership
  chatter — to surface the combinations that actually mean something.
  Predictions
  Forecast
  Mid-market
  enterprise launch
  Hiring, product, and brand signals align one direction.
  Within 60 days
  High confidence
  PredictFrom the patterns, we forecast what's coming next — product launches, market entries,
  acquisitions, organizational pivots — each with a time horizon and confidence score. You see the
  move before it's made, not after the press release.

# Homepage

[View our Products!][18]

IMS provides [analytic services & data management][19], [web and application development][20],
[managed computing services][21], and [clinical trial support][22]. [Our products][23] are trusted
by researchers and organizations worldwide. We collaborate on research published in major scientific
journals and featured in the news.

## Analytic and web solutions for researchers and organizations worldwide

50+

YEARS

IMS has 50 plus years of information technology and clinical trials experience. We develop
sophisticated software products and Web applications in support of biomedical research. Our clients
include the National Cancer Institute, the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, and major
pharmaceutical firms.

Our corporate philosophy is to hire entry-level staff and to promote from within. We create an
environment where stress is lower than typical IT firms, and encourage [employees][24] to do their
best at work, while respecting their personal time. As a result, we deliver high quality products to
[our customers][25] and have an extremely low turnover rate.

We offer premium services at competitive prices. In addition, IMS participates with the following
government funding mechanisms.

[[CIO-SP3 small business logo]][26] [[GSA Advantage! Information Technology (IT) Services logo]][27]

# Pharmaceutical Market Intelligence Platform

Compare drug prices, suppliers, registrations, and shortages across global pharmaceutical markets.

BOOK A PLATFORM DEMO
[product preview] Your browser does not support the video tag.

PharmaFootpath unifies global drug pricing, supplier data, registrations, shortages, and clinical
trial information into a single searchable platform. Instantly reveal market opportunities,
empowering procurement teams, wholesalers, and parallel traders to act quickly and confidently
across countries.

[MYONEX]
[RxSource]
[Eureco Pharma]
[Ideal Trade Links]
[Corex]
[Tanner Pharma]
[Ikris Pharma Network]
[Kora Healthcare]

## Pharmaceutical Market Data Is Fragmented

Pharmaceutical pricing, registrations, shortages, and supplier data are spread across national
databases, regulatory agencies, and market reports. For procurement teams and pharmaceutical
traders, gathering this information can take hours or days.

Fragmented landscape slows decision-making and limits visibility into international opportunities.

### TEAMS MUST OFTEN
* Search multiple regulatory databases
* Compare pricing between markets
* Identify licensed suppliers
* Monitor product shortages
* Track product registrations and competition

## Meet A Single Platform for Pharmaceutical Market Intelligence

PharmaFootpath aggregates pharmaceutical market data from official sources and organizes it in a
searchable cloud platform. Users can explore pharmaceutical markets in seconds, not hours.

[pill icon]

### Drug Price Comparison

Compare drug prices by country and spot new market opportunities.

[suppliers icon]

### Supplier Discovery

Find licensed distributors and wholesalers globally.

[shortage icon]

### Shortage Monitoring

Monitor medicine shortages and supply disruptions worldwide.

[arrows icon]

### Regulatory Intelligence

Access product registrations and parallel trade licenses.

## See how PharmaFootpath works in your market

Schedule a Demo

## Get Market Clarity in Seconds

### Product Explorer

Review the registration information for multiple countries in a single unified database. Filter
information by MA holders, countries, presentations, strengths, pack sizes, and other
characteristics.

### Price Comparison

Prices are converted to the currency of your choice, with daily updated currency exchange rates.
This lets you compare prices globally in a single screen, immediately.

Order information by prices, or by the largest changes in prices over the last 30 days.

### Clinical Trial Register

Search through multiple clinical trial registers in a single interface, connected to the drug
registration data and market data of PharmaFootpath.

This helps you to select a drug name or API, and then review global clinical trials currently
running with this.

### Drug Shortage Monitoring

Monitoring drug shortages is an important task, but the volume of information can be difficult to
manage.

PharmaFootpath collects and structures shortage information into a single interface, monitoring
trends to highlight the API with which there are increasing supply disruption signals.

## Built for Pharmaceutical Trade and Procurement

### Procurement Teams

Procurement teams can efficiently search multiple markets, compare pricing, and identify suppliers.

### Parallel Traders

Parallel traders can track product registrations, monitor competition, and find arbitrage
opportunities across EU markets.

### Clinical Trial Supply Teams

Clinical trial supply teams can identify global product availability and find new sourcing
opportunities.

### Pharmaceutical Wholesalers

Pharmaceutical wholesalers can find new suppliers, partners, and international trade opportunities.

## Find sourcing opportunities across global pharmaceutical markets

Schedule a Demo

## Official Pharmaceutical Sources

PharmaFootpath gathers pharmaceutical market data from official national organizations, regulatory
databases, and verified sources. Shortage data is updated daily, and most datasets are refreshed
weekly, so users have the latest information.
* Pharmaceutical pricing
* Product registrations
* Shortages and supply disruptions
* Clinical trials
* Supplier licenses

## Trusted by Pharmaceutical Trade Professionals

> Pharma Footpath has become a valuable part of how we shape our sourcing strategy for commercial
> drugs in clinical trials. The platform gives us clear visibility of the supply landscape including
> product availability, pricing dynamics, and emerging shortages, which helps us make more informed,
> proactive sourcing decisions. It has also strengthened our internal knowledge base and improved
> how we anticipate and manage sourcing challenges.

Matt Grace

Senior Directo

## Frequently Asked Questions

What is PharmaFootpath?

PharmaFootpath is a pharmaceutical market intelligence platform that aggregates drug prices,
supplier information, product registrations, shortages, clinical trials, and licensing data into one
searchable system for pharmaceutical traders, wholesalers, and procurement teams.

Who uses PharmaFootpath?

PharmaFootpath is used by pharmaceutical procurement teams, parallel traders, wholesalers, and
clinical trial supply companies that need visibility into pharmaceutical markets across multiple
countries.

Where does PharmaFootpath source its data?

PharmaFootpath gathers pharmaceutical market data from official national organizations, regulatory
agencies, and verified public sources to ensure reliable information.

How often is the data updated?

Medicine shortage data is updated daily, while most other datasets, such as product registrations
and pricing, are updated weekly depending on the source schedule.

What markets does PharmaFootpath cover?

PharmaFootpath focuses on European pharmaceutical markets with additional coverage for Switzerland,
UK, USA, Canada, Australia, Brazil, UAE, and Saudi Arabia.

We are continually expanding our market offerings. If you’re interested in a market not listed,
please contact us to check when it will be added!

How does PharmaFootpath help pharmaceutical procurement teams?

We identify where products are registered and commercialised, price information, who the
distributors are for the products, and various other details that accelerate sourcing products.

How does PharmaFootpath support parallel trade?

PharmaFootpath monitors and publishes both centrally authorised and national level parallel trade
licenses in Europe. We identify the origins of national parallel trade licenses, as well as review
and publish trends in the parallel trade markets.

How is PharmaFootpath different from traditional pharma data providers?

We're focussed on providing data to support international pharmaceutical businesses. Particularly
those looking to source internationally, export to new markets, identify unlicensed medicines, or
considering launching portfolio products internationally.

How can I access PharmaFootpath?

PharmaFootpath is a cloud based application, so is accessible from any laptop or PC with internet
access.

## Frequently Asked Questions

What is PharmaFootpath?

PharmaFootpath is a pharmaceutical market intelligence platform that aggregates drug prices,
supplier information, product registrations, shortages, clinical trials, and licensing data into one
searchable system for pharmaceutical traders, wholesalers, and procurement teams.

Who uses PharmaFootpath?

PharmaFootpath is used by pharmaceutical procurement teams, parallel traders, wholesalers, and
clinical trial supply companies that need visibility into pharmaceutical markets across multiple
countries.

Where does PharmaFootpath source its data?

PharmaFootpath gathers pharmaceutical market data from official national organizations, regulatory
agencies, and verified public sources to ensure reliable information.

How often is the data updated?

Medicine shortage data is updated daily, while most other datasets, such as product registrations
and pricing, are updated weekly depending on the source schedule.

What markets does PharmaFootpath cover?

PharmaFootpath focuses on European pharmaceutical markets with additional coverage for Switzerland,
UK, USA, Canada, Australia, Brazil, UAE, and Saudi Arabia.

We are continually expanding our market offerings. If you’re interested in a market not listed,
please contact us to check when it will be added!

How does PharmaFootpath help pharmaceutical procurement teams?

We identify where products are registered and commercialised, price information, who the
distributors are for the products, and various other details that accelerate sourcing products.

How does PharmaFootpath support parallel trade?

PharmaFootpath monitors and publishes both centrally authorised and national level parallel trade
licenses in Europe. We identify the origins of national parallel trade licenses, as well as review
and publish trends in the parallel trade markets.

How is PharmaFootpath different from traditional pharma data providers?

We're focussed on providing data to support international pharmaceutical businesses. Particularly
those looking to source internationally, export to new markets, identify unlicensed medicines, or
considering launching portfolio products internationally.

How can I access PharmaFootpath?

PharmaFootpath is a cloud based application, so is accessible from any laptop or PC with internet
access.

### Welcome to Xenon Health

###### The Future of Anesthesia Care Delivery is Here


Xenon Health represents the paradigmatic shift in healthcare delivery. We are an anesthesia
management company focused on embracing the perpetual changes in healthcare policy and delivering
value-added perioperative care to surgical and procedure-based facilities throughout the nation. We
are an organization that aims to perfect and effectively integrate every vertical process of the
anesthesia care delivery continuum.

### serving surgical facilities nationwide

Xenon Health is a physician-led management company that provides
comprehensive anesthesia services nationwide.

## Anesthesia Services

At Xenon Health, we bring our expertise in the various facets of anesthesia management to ambulatory
surgical centers, office-based surgical practices, and hospitals.

## Effective and Experienced

With over a decade of experience in anesthesia management and deployment of managed anesthesia care
in seventeen states, we are committed to providing perioperative care where and when it is needed.
As a physician-led organization, our fundamental focus is clinical excellence and enhancing the
patient experience. Our client partners have seen measurable and sustainable improvements in the
following:
* **Operational Efficiency**
* **Effective Leadership**

## Haroon Chaudhry, MD

###### President and Chief Executive Officer

Bio

Dr. Chaudhry has twenty years of clinical and administrative experience in the field of
anesthesiology. He has worked at a level one, inner-city trauma center and a suburban pain
management practice and spent nearly a decade working in the ambulatory anesthesia setting. He has
grown Xenon Health from a provider of anesthesia care to a single metropolitan area into a
nationwide conglomerate. He holds a bachelor’s degree from Columbia, an MD from Temple and completed
his anesthesiology residency at the Mount Sinai School of Medicine in New York City.

## Ramesh Gajraj, JD

###### VP and General Counsel

Bio

Ramesh specializes in corporate practice and health care law. After earning his AB from Harvard, an
MBA from INSEAD and a JD from Yale, he launched his legal career as an associate at the law firm of
Paul, Weiss, Rifkind, Wharton and Garrison in New York.

## Hasan Qazi

###### Director of Operations

Bio

As a director of operations at Xenon Health, Hasan strives to ensure that all operations run
smoothly and effectively. Along with vast knowledge in the field of medicine (He is a graduate of
Jinnah Medical College), his expertise in IT, strong work ethic and dedication to success enable him
to take on complex tasks and perform them efficiently. During his free time, Hasan loves to travel,
read books and meet new people.

## Alexander Lembersky

###### Billing

Bio

Alexander brings the background and skills needed to effectively lead the revenue cycle department
at Xenon Health. He has almost two decades of experience in billing, coding and collections. A 1998
graduate of The American Academy of Procedural Coders, he is a certified procedural coder (CPC). He
has also been certified by the National Health Career Association as a Coding and Billing
Specialist.

## CJ Tuan

###### Business Development

Bio

CJ, a graduate of Northwestern University with a degree in Neuroscience and minors in global health
and data science, has a strong passion for the healthcare industry. In her role as a business
development associate, CJ explores the business side of medicine, using her communicative and
analytical skills to drive business expansion and solve problems. CJ enjoys interacting with clients
and finds fulfillment in making a positive impact in the medical industry. Apart from her dedication
to healthcare, she also finds joy in reading, cooking, and exploring different restaurants.

## Dedicated Anesthesia Services and Perioperative Care for Communities Nationwide

### Welcome to Xenon Health

###### The Future of Anesthesia Care Delivery is Here


Xenon Health represents the paradigmatic shift in healthcare delivery. We are an anesthesia
management company focused on embracing the perpetual changes in healthcare policy and delivering
value-added perioperative care to surgical and procedure-based facilities throughout the nation. We
are an organization that aims to perfect and effectively integrate every vertical process of the
anesthesia care delivery continuum.

### serving surgical facilities nationwide

Xenon Health is a physician-led management company that provides
comprehensive anesthesia services nationwide.

## Anesthesia Services

At Xenon Health, we bring our expertise in the various facets of anesthesia management to ambulatory
surgical centers, office-based surgical practices, and hospitals.

As a physician-led organization, our fundamental focus is clinical excellence and enhancing the

###### President and Chief Executive Officer

Bio

Dr. Chaudhry has twenty years of clinical and administrative experience in the field of
anesthesiology. He has worked at a level one, inner-city trauma center and a suburban pain
management practice and spent nearly a decade working in the ambulatory anesthesia setting. He has
grown Xenon Health from a provider of anesthesia care to a single metropolitan area into a
nationwide conglomerate. He holds a bachelor’s degree from Columbia, an MD from Temple and completed
his anesthesiology residency at the Mount Sinai School of Medicine in New York City.

## Ramesh Gajraj, JD

###### VP and General Counsel

Bio

Ramesh specializes in corporate practice and health care law. After earning his AB from Harvard, an
MBA from INSEAD and a JD from Yale, he launched his legal career as an associate at the law firm of
Paul, Weiss, Rifkind, Wharton and Garrison in New York.

## Hasan Qazi

###### Director of Operations

Bio

As a director of operations at Xenon Health, Hasan strives to ensure that all operations run
smoothly and effectively. Along with vast knowledge in the field of medicine (He is a graduate of
Jinnah Medical College), his expertise in IT, strong work ethic and dedication to success enable him
to take on complex tasks and perform them efficiently. During his free time, Hasan loves to travel,
read books and meet new people.

## Alexander Lembersky

###### Billing

Bio

Alexander brings the background and skills needed to effectively lead the revenue cycle department
at Xenon Health. He has almost two decades of experience in billing, coding and collections. A 1998
graduate of The American Academy of Procedural Coders, he is a certified procedural coder (CPC). He
has also been certified by the National Health Career Association as a Coding and Billing
Specialist.

## CJ Tuan

###### Business Development

Bio

CJ, a graduate of Northwestern University with a degree in Neuroscience and minors in global health
and data science, has a strong passion for the healthcare industry. In her role as a business
development associate, CJ explores the business side of medicine, using her communicative and
